newsitem.title: USA: LILCO /Brooklyn Union deal positive - LIPA.
newsitem.headline: LILCO /Brooklyn Union deal positive - LIPA.

text.p: The Long Island Power Authority said on Sunday that it sees the announcement made by Long Island Lighting Co (LILCO) and Brooklyn Union Gas Co (BUG) as a positive development.
"LIPA has always believed that a LILCO consolidation with one or more of the downstate utilities would benefit the ratepayers of Long Island," LIPA said in a press release.

"We greet the announcement made by LILCO and BUG as a positive development which will help us to complete negotiations on a plan to reduce utility rates and introduce long-term competition on Long Island.
The organization said that its objective of bringing double-digit rate reductions would be enhanced by having a utility with a stronger balance sheet already in place on Long Island.
